findings.reviewer: independent contract reviewer (C14 review rounds 2 and 3)
findings.basis: The vanilla creative-inventory tab with its outline redrawn: 92 % of its opaque pixels equal 1.20.1 creative_inventory/tabs.png at (1, 34) and 94 % flipped in five more vanilla sheets (C14R2-H1). The equal pixels are the tab fill and one bevel edge, which the derivation check's dominant-colour rule does not count, so the check alone scores it SUSPECT or CLEAR; this finding keeps it excluded, and its tab-button derivatives inherit review (ADR-061 section 4.8).
